description: Land Acquisition - Kuruwamba, Bibila D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple parcels of land being acquired by the government for road improvement. It includes detailed descriptions of land lots, their names, claimants, prior owners/encroachers, and exact measurements. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, focusing on land acquisitions and property ownership details without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
